fields.name: question
fields.note: The weather market forecast question to answer (e.g. 'Will NYC max temperature exceed 90°F on July 4th?'). Should reference a specific Polymarket weather market or be phrased to match one.

fields.name: resolution_criteria
fields.note: Optional. The settlement station, measurement window, and source table (e.g. KLGA, max temp, NOAA ISD). The oracle will verify this against Polymarket's settlement spec.

fields.name: context
fields.note: Optional. Market context: current Polymarket price, order book depth, existing ensemble forecasts.
